Built like a startup product, not a static demo.

The existing studio remains the core experience. The landing page now explains the value proposition and routes directly into it.

3D worldbuilding that teaches systems thinking

Learners sketch ideas as spatial compositions, balancing housing, ecology, culture, and infrastructure in one shared scene.

Challenge-led progression instead of an empty sandbox

Every mission frames a design problem and turns broad creativity into concrete goals, tradeoffs, and outcomes.

AI roles that coach, critique, and motivate iteration

The platform combines a tutor, a critic, and a live challenge engine so feedback feels like a studio review, not a toy.

CHALLENGE / TUTOR / CRITIC
Three systems work together to create the learning loop.

Instead of generic AI chat, the product uses role-based guidance tied directly to what the learner has built.
